thesis: Apple qualifies as an intact-trend candidate, but the evidence does not show a superior entry after accounting for cash conversion and valuation uncertainty. The bear has not shown business impairment, and the bull has not shown a clear current price advantage.
strongest_counterexample: Positive comparable revenue and profit growth, substantial FCF, declining debt and positive medium- and long-term price trends supply a credible trend-following case without requiring a deep discount.
invalidation_conditions: Reconsider toward buy if the next reported quarter shows higher year-over-year FCF and price sustains a new observed range high for five consecutive closes.
Reconsider toward sell if revenue declines year over year for two reports and operating margin falls below the current observation in both.
evidence_gaps: Authenticated current valuation and reported EPS share basis.
Quantified earnings impact, if any, of the service incident.
decisive_factors: Quarterly FCF below the year-ago observation.
Positive trend is established but valuation protection is not.
